An off-site copy that takes longer than two hours is no longer cancelled as stalled.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A long off-site copy after a backup was cancelled after two hours.** The stall guard kept counting through retention and the off-site copy, which report no progress to it, so a copy that ran longer than two hours after **Back up now** stopped with `cancelled after 2h0m0s without progress` and could never finish. It now counts only while the backup itself runs. Scheduled runs and **Replicate now** were not affected. ([support thread](https://forums.unraid.net/topic/199509-support-junkerderprovinz-bombvault/))

## Upgrading

- **Nothing has to be changed.**
